text: In California, mail ballots are only counted if the race is close.
seenIn: a group chat on election night

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Vote by Mail
truthSource.oneLine: All valid vote-by-mail ballots are counted in every California election, regardless of the outcome or how close any race is.

lesson.tip: Mail ballots are counted for days after polls close, so totals shift. Counted late isn’t uncounted. If results move overnight, check the county’s count schedule before calling it suspicious.
